title: Record the FFT setup sum
body:
## Summary
- The three FFT setup terms `r(ell+1)p0^2`, `r p0^3` and `p0^3` add to at most `1017/7` times `n beta^2` for every width from 3 through `2^22`.
- Width 7 meets the bound with equality: the sum is 9,153 and `n beta^2` is 63.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
